description: This file implements a class for managing tab session history, including back and forward navigation stacks, within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: TabSessionHistory
classes.description: A class that manages tab session history, including back and forward stacks, for navigation within tabs.

methods.name: getBackStack
methods.description: Retrieves a copy of the back stack for a given tab ID.

methods.name: getForwardStack
methods.description: Retrieves a copy of the forward stack for a given tab ID.

methods.name: setBackStack
methods.description: Sets the back stack for a specific tab ID and updates the canGoBack flag.

methods.name: setForwardStack
methods.description: Sets the forward stack for a specific tab ID and updates the canGoForward flag.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new session ID to the back stack of a tab, generating a new ID if not provided.

methods.name: clearStackForTab
methods.description: Clears both back and forward stacks for a specific tab.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Navigates back in the tab history, updating stacks accordingly.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific session ID from either the back or forward stack of a tab.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Navigates forward in the tab history, updating stacks accordingly.

methods.name: currentSessionId
methods.description: Returns the current session ID for a tab.

methods.name: getTabHistory
methods.description: Returns the back and forward stacks for a tab.

methods.name: canGoBack
methods.description: Checks if navigation back is possible for a tab.

methods.name: canGoForward
methods.description: Checks if navigation forward is possible for a tab.
